name: desktop
_doc: The desktop pack (owner request R-0239, contract): 2 desk-* SPECIALIST agents plus the existing specialist electron-pro by reference (never Bosses; the 12 permanent Bosses are unchanged) for Windows desktop apps (.exe, Electron), built from the roles the owner projects really used (the accounting desktop app: engine, shell, installer, ui). forge-router sends desktop work to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Lanes open the presets desktop-all and process first (checked by forge-lane-skills.cjs --require desktop-all,process).
